subject: fixing a 12-item flat navigation
ruling: DEC-01 wins: cap top-level navigation at five to seven items first, then place the critical destination first and the setting last within that shorter set.

subject: the Cmd/Ctrl+K search shortcut
ruling: HMM-01's never-hijack check wins over its own Cmd/Ctrl+K example: a binding the browser already owns cannot be taught as a convention, so the remedy uses / instead.
